acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode.
cleavage agent: in-gel digestion with Asp-N... subjected to in-gel digestion with Lys-C and Trypsin
collision energy: normalized collision energy of 35%, normalized collision energy of 30
Fragmentation was performed with normalized collision energy of 35%... HCD fragmentation with normalized collision energy of 30
enrichment method: ubiquitinated Flag-VPS34 was isolated by immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag M2 beads
fractionation method: the Lbpro*-treated reaction was separated by SDS-PAGE
fragmentation method: The ten most intense ions were sequentially isolated for HCD MS/MS fragmentation
instrument: LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer, Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Luoms mass spectrometer
connected to the LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer... connected to an Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Luoms mass spectrometer
labeling: For label-free quantification, precursor ions intensities were extracted
